reviewText: Excellent interface and stable connection even on mobile data. Kudos to Netflix, Inc. for this polished experience.
Clean layout and intuitive rules. Performance is smooth, would just appreciate a toggle for low-power mode.
Overall a solid experience with Netflix. The gameplay is very fluid, just hoping the next update adds more custom card themes.
Decent performance and fair matchmaking, but the sound effects can get slightly repetitive. Good casual app overall.
